intro: Section A General Awareness carries 20 marks in every DSSSB paper: about 8 current-affairs and 12 static-GK questions. In the 4 official 2023–24 TGT CS papers ({n} questions) the static part leaned on art & culture, medieval and modern history, Census 2011, polity basics, geography and class-10 science; current affairs asked schemes, appointments, awards, sports and science & tech of the previous 6–12 months. The notes are short tables; the current-affairs chapter is a sourced capsule for February–October 2026.
